Looking at the test file spec/models/topic_embed_spec.rb, the test 'creates the topic' only verifies `expect(post.topic.category).to eq(embeddable_host.category)` with a single embeddable_host. There's no test that creates topics from different hosts with different category mappings to verify the category selection works correctly. This is a legitimate test coverage gap for new functionality - if the category_id retrieval were broken or removed, the existing tests would still pass since they only test one host scenario.
